title: Galadon map route planner with legacy live-verification subset
coverage: Complete literal + node inventory and cardinal corridor parsing for the published Galadon map, with source-supported shop, guild, gate, Market Square, and priority-room labels; diagonal and unclear special connections remain explicit ambiguities.

source_map.title: Galadon
source_map.last_modified_display: This page was last modified on 9 October 2026, at 03:37.
source_map.freshness_warning: The source itself says the map is slightly outdated. Capture date is not geometry freshness.
source_map.coordinate_system: 1-based Unicode character row and column in the preserved preformatted map. Coordinates are evidence locators, not movement counts.

contract.resolver: resolve_room(name) returns one stable node ID or an explicit ambiguity/unknown result. Requested names never prove current character location.
contract.planner: plan_route(start_id, goal_id, graph_version, actual_observation) uses command-weighted shortest paths only over directed edges with complete per-command expected observations and provenance. OK or ALREADY_THERE requires a fresh observation identifier and a verified world/area/title/description/exits fingerprint; title-only localization is rejected.
contract.counts: movement_count counts emitted movement commands. plus_cells_crossed separately records literal + evidence when known. They are never substituted for one another.
contract.execution: This rescue reference never controls a character. A separate authorized play agent may execute only an executable plan, after announcing it, verifying every movement, and stopping on stale localization, takeover, failure, or an unresolved special exit.
contract.map_planner: planMapRoute(start_map_node, destination_map_node) calculates directions directly from the published ASCII map without requiring a live-game fingerprint. Each adjacent + room or named landmark transition counts as one movement; copy_commands expands each command separated by exactly two semicolons with no trailing separator. The result remains explicitly map-derived and directions-only.

source_evidence.statement: From market square, head 4n, 2w, n, 3w, and north.

blockers: Market Square is named in the guide but not anchored to the Galadon ASCII map or current room output.
The 2019 prose supplies no intermediate expected room observations for the 11 movements.
Current-world validity has not been confirmed.

localization_rules.focused_step: For later live-verification only, record the actual current Market Square room title, description, exits, and the result of one manually issued north command. This rescue task must not issue the command.

map_route.title: Galadon map-derived cardinal routing graph
map_route.basis: Every literal + is a room node. Named landmarks split a corridor and count as their own transition. Only unbroken horizontal - and vertical | corridors are connected automatically.
map_route.live_verification: Not required to calculate a route. Results are map-derived directions, not proof of current live-world geometry.

observation_priorities.area: Market Square (historical M anchor) and central Trade Road
observation_priorities.needed: For future live validation only, record exact room titles, descriptions, and visible exits at Market Square plus one step west and east. This confirms whether the historical triangulation still matches the current world.
Follow the short map route e, s, s, e and record the exact room title and exits after each single move. Five observations name the tested rectangle path.

Record the exact room title and exits immediately west of E, at E, and immediately east. Three observations confirm the gate transition without mapping the district.

ambiguities: Diagonal / and \ links are displayed but not routed until their endpoints are manually traced.
Crossings and special exits such as J are not inferred from character proximity.

The source legend does not define M directly. Market Square is assigned to M by independent historical room-description triangulation using the mapped Bakery, Butcher, Vegetable Shop, Cartographer's Store, and the user's one-south-of-center report. This is useful historical mapping evidence, not a current live-room fingerprint.

invariants: No automatic diagonal, crossing, bridge, whitespace-gap, or map-boundary connection.
No zero-command teleport between adjacent labels.
E, NE, NW, N, S, and W map tokens are landmarks unless an edge explicitly supplies commands.
Only validated executable edges with an observed-start contract participate in command-weighted routing.
